Run the study's AI answers through: collect, build, status, questions

Source: R/ai_agent.R
tfl_ai_run.Rd

What a coding agent runs after each answer it saves (run.R of tfl_ai_prepare()(mode = "agent") calls it): tfl_ai_collect_answers() (read, check, write the report files, a repair prompt for an answer with errors), then each report written (ok, warning) built – its ARD (tfl_build_ard()) and its RTF (rtfreporter) into the study's output_path – one report's failure not stopping the others. It writes ai/status.md (each report's status, its RTF or why none, each request's next step, the questions open) and gathers the answers' questions (an assumption's question) into ai/questions.md: one question once, with every report that asks it; a question there already is kept as it is – its answer, its status – with the new reports added to its list. Nothing is sent anywhere.

Usage

tfl_ai_run(study_dir = ".", rtf = TRUE, requests = NULL, rebuild = FALSE)

Arguments

study_dir

The study folder.

rtf

FALSE to build the ARDs only (no rtfreporter).

requests

The requests whose reports are built ("ae-1"); NULL (the default): every request's. Every answer is still read and checked, and ai/status.md lists them all. Rscript run.R ae-1 passes them.

rebuild

TRUE to build every report again, changed or not.

Value

A tfl_ai_collected (as tfl_ai_collect_answers()) whose reports also have rtf (the file made, else NA), rtf_problem and built ("built", "kept" – unchanged since the last run – or NA), and a questions data frame (n, question, reports, status, answer), invisibly.

Details

A report is built again only when it changed: its report file, the study's files (study.yml, spec/data.yml, spec/defaults.yml, its templates), the ADaM it reads or the packages' versions – else its RTF (and PNG) of the last run is kept, as ai/built.csv says. A report that passed its checks but could not be built gets a repair (ai/repairs/<request>-build.md) with why, which stays until the request's reports are built; its RTF (and PNG) of an earlier run are removed, and ai/built.csv keeps why, so that a run of other requests still says it. A report not built yet (only other requests run) says so in ai/status.md.

See also

tfl_ai_prepare() (mode = "agent").
